title: Take-home, pairing or live coding: what each one actually measures

videos.script: Somewhere in every engineering hiring process, somebody has to find out whether a candidate can write code. {{title}} There are three usual ways. A problem taken home. A session pairing with somebody on the team. Or code written live, while somebody watches. {{three}} Each one measures the job. Each one also measures something else. Free time. Comfort with being watched. Nerves. {{else}} This lesson is about choosing between them by starting from the job, not from habit. {{choose}} About what Caju chose for its new role, and why. {{caju}} And about making any of them fairer. The same conditions for everybody, real tools, and a way to ask for an adjustment. {{fair}}
